evidence.note: Refrigerator main door is closed; user has approached the handle side.
User's hand is at the refrigerator door edge and begins pulling it open.
Refrigerator main door is fully open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Refrigerator remains open after the extended inspection period.
User grips the refrigerator door and pushes it toward the frame.
Refrigerator main door is closed.

events.object_description: Main upper door of the stainless-steel refrigerator

evidence.note: Both wooden cabinet doors above the cooktop/range hood appear closed.
Left cabinet compartment is exposed, indicating the first door has just been opened.
Both cabinet leaves are visibly open around the exposed compartment.
User begins closing the open cabinet leaves; exact leaf ordering is partially ambiguous.
The left/first cabinet leaf is being brought flush and the cabinet is closed immediately afterward.

events.object_description: Left door leaf of the wooden cabinet above the cooktop/range hood

evidence.note: First cabinet leaf is open while the second leaf still appears closed.
User's hand is pulling the second wooden cabinet leaf outward.
Second cabinet leaf is fully open, with both sides of the compartment exposed.
Cabinet compartment and open leaf remain visible.
User starts the sequential cabinet-closing action.
Second leaf appears closed while the remaining leaf is being finished.

events.object_description: Right door leaf of the wooden cabinet above the cooktop/range hood

evidence.note: User reaches for the handle of the top drawer immediately to the right of the stove.
Top drawer is pulled open, revealing utensils and stored items.
The same utensil drawer remains open.
User pushes the drawer inward with a hand on its front.
Drawer is fully closed and flush with the cabinet.

events.object_description: Top utensil drawer in the narrow cabinet to the right of the stove

notes: Four distinct localized interaction episodes are visible. The two independently manipulated leaves of the cabinet above the cooktop are reported separately. The refrigerator and utensil drawer each remain continuously open between their opening and closing actions despite repeated camera repositioning.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens and later closes the refrigerator, independently opens and closes two cabinet-door leaves above the cooktop, and opens and later closes the top utensil drawer beside the stove.
